summary: Processed all 17 open damage tickets (501-517) in id order: 503 and 508 were already recorded (adj-201, adj-203) and resolved; 12 others got a new damage adjustment (adj-206 to adj-217) and were resolved; 511, 513 and 517 had insufficient stock and were set to pending. Note: the reference-filtered adjustment lookup for TCK-513 returned an odd adj-9406 that was absent from the unfiltered and sku/warehouse lists; I relied on the unfiltered list (adj-204 -4, adj-205 +4 net 0).
